  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Sales" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Sales">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Marketing" name="Marketing staff">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Sales</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DetermineDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Source</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BuyDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Exhibition</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Acquaintance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Contacts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CallCenter" name="Call center staff">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CallCustomer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DetermineContact</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AskInterest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Interest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Budget</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LeaveAlone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_LeftAlone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_InterestMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_FinalInterest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NotInterested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HeadDev" name="Head of development">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AcquireCustomer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesRep" name="Sales representative">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_TechPresentation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OnlinePresentation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_PresentationMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Wait</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_TwoWeeks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CallAgain</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_CustomerContacts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_QuoteMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateQuotation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Quotation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_PreSales" name="Pre-sales employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TechPresentation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Sales" name="Start" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineDetails" name="Determine contact details of potential customers" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Source" name="Source of contact?" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyDetails" name="Buy contact details for cold calls" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Exhibition" name="Participate in exhibitions" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Acquaintance" name="Obtain contact through an acquaintance" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Contacts" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CallCustomer" name="Call the customer" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineContact" name="Determine the contact person and the budget" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AskInterest" name="Ask whether the customer is generally interested" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Interest" name="Generally interested?" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Budget" name="Potential project budget huge?" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveAlone" name="Leave the customer alone" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LeftAlone" name="Customer left alone" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_InterestMerge" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_FinalInterest" name="Customer interested in the end?" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotInterested" name="Customer not interested" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AcquireCustomer" name="Acquire the customer personally" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_TechPresentation" name="Technical presentation?" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OnlinePresentation" name="Give detailed online presentation" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TechPresentation" name="Give detailed technical online presentation" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_PresentationMerge" />
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gw_Wait" name="Wait for the customer" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_TwoWeeks" name="Two weeks passed">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P14D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CallAgain" name="Call the customer again" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_CustomerContacts" name="Customer contacts us">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Msg_CustomerContacts" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_QuoteMerge" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateQuotation" name="Create quotation" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Quotation" name="Quotation created" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_01" sourceRef="Start_Sales" targetRef="Task_DetermineDetails" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_10" sourceRef="Task_CallCustomer" targetRef="Task_DetermineContact" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_11" sourceRef="Task_DetermineContact" targetRef="Task_AskInterest" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_12" sourceRef="Task_AskInterest" targetRef="Gw_Interest" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_13" name="yes" sourceRef="Gw_Interest" targetRef="Gw_InterestMerge" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_17" sourceRef="Task_LeaveAlone" targetRef="End_LeftAlone" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_18" sourceRef="Task_AcquireCustomer" targetRef="Gw_InterestMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_19" sourceRef="Gw_InterestMerge" targetRef="Gw_FinalInterest" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_20" name="yes" sourceRef="Gw_FinalInterest" targetRef="Gw_TechPresentation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_21" name="no" sourceRef="Gw_FinalInterest" targetRef="End_NotInterested" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_22" name="yes" sourceRef="Gw_TechPresentation" targetRef="Task_TechPresentation" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_33" sourceRef="Task_CreateQuotation" targetRef="End_Quotation" />
